title: Keep sender intent status reachable when one native creation spans placement epochs
outcome: Reusing an intent key under a new placement epoch cannot persist a row then make both old and new outcomes unreachable, and callers can select the exact retained authority namespace safely.
acceptance: Status, retry, cancel and GC address an exact retained namespace or report an actionable epoch selection without adopting authority from an old binding.
Preparing the same key in a newer epoch cannot silently strand the newly persisted row behind an ambiguous lookup.
Regressions cover identical owner/creation/key across different placement generations and preserve original digest/outcome/target fencing.
